glosses: flock, a large number of birds, especially gathered together for the purpose of migration

examples.text: Tom me fez um bando de perguntas.
examples.en: Tom asked me a bunch of questions.
We saw a pride of lions.

examples.text: O jovem salvou a garota de um bando de bandidos.
examples.en: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.
